stories.headline: Zepto Pauses IPO Amid Valuation Concerns, To Raise ₹1,000 Cr Pre-IPO Round
stories.gist: Quick-commerce unicorn Zepto shelves its IPO for now and will raise about Rs 1,000 crore from existing investors in a pre-IPO round instead.

stories.headline: Fields Medal Winner Jacob Tsimerman Joins OpenAI, Says AI Will Soon Do Everything Mathematicians Do 'Better And Faster'
stories.gist: 2026 Fields Medalist Jacob Tsimerman is leaving the University of Toronto to join OpenAI's AI safety research team.

stories.headline: White House AI Framework Deadline Lapses Without Public Deliverables
stories.gist: The federal government missed its self-imposed August 1 deadline to publish a frontier AI review framework, leaving labs without regulatory clarity.

stories.headline: Chinese Hacker Commands DeepSeek via Telegram to Launch Autonomous Attacks
stories.gist: A Chinese-speaking threat actor directed DeepSeek's AI agent against 460+ targets via Telegram, with confirmed compromises including Citrix systems.

stories.headline: Sam Altman is still making the case for parenting via ChatGPT
stories.gist: Altman renewed his pitch that ChatGPT can help with parenting, drawing heavy online backlash that outpaced supportive reactions.

stories.headline: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is 'not healthy'
stories.gist: The science YouTuber admitted heavy reliance on ChatGPT for scriptwriting and paused several of his channels over it.

stories.headline: Apple tightens bug reporting as AI floods security teams
stories.gist: Apple capped Feedback Assistant submissions and added a 30-day cool-off period after being swamped with low-quality AI-generated bug reports.

stories.headline: Smallest.ai raises $13M to build ultra-fast voice AI that sounds genuinely human
stories.gist: Bengaluru-based Smallest.ai raised $13M to build low-latency, human-sounding voice AI models for enterprise customer service.

stories.headline: UPI hits highest ever monthly volume with 23.66 Bn transactions in July
stories.gist: India's UPI processed a record 23.66 billion transactions worth Rs 29.88 lakh crore in July, its highest-ever monthly volume.

stories.headline: Mark Zuckerberg Is Betting Up to $145 Billion on AI Infrastructure in 2026
stories.gist: Meta raised its 2026 AI capex guidance to as much as $145 billion as it races to build out data centers.

stories.headline: China's humanoid robots have been taking over the global market. Now the US is banning them
stories.gist: The FCC moved to ban new approvals of Chinese-made humanoid/quadruped robots and grid inverters over national-security concerns, hitting market leader Unitree hardest.

stories.headline: Balaji Srinivasan's Network School relocates to Kazakhstan after Malaysian authorities pull the plug
stories.gist: Malaysia revoked the operating license for Srinivasan's 'Network School' pop-up community, which pivoted within about a day to a new Kazakhstan partnership.

stories.headline: CoreWeave said to sweeten $2.6 billion loan terms amid debt concerns
stories.gist: AI cloud provider CoreWeave raised the yield on a $2.6B loan tied to its Anthropic-linked expansion as debt investors grow more cautious on AI infrastructure credit.

stories.headline: LG unveils 750 bil.-parameter frontier AI model K-EXAONE 2.0
stories.gist: LG AI Research open-sourced K-EXAONE 2.0, a 750B-parameter model it calls Korea's largest, supporting 10 languages under an Apache license.

stories.headline: Commission starts enforcing AI Act rules and new transparency requirements on 2 August
stories.gist: The EU began enforcing the next tier of AI Act obligations, including new transparency rules for general-purpose AI model providers.

stories.headline: Indian startup funding drops to $662 Mn in July after June spike
stories.gist: Indian startup funding fell roughly 67% month-on-month to about $662 million in July, per Entrackr's monthly tracker.

stories.headline: Chinese VC Firms Seek $35 Billion as Fundraising Rebounds After 3-Year Drought
stories.gist: Chinese venture firms are reopening capital flows toward domestic AI and robotics startups after a three-year fundraising drought.
